name: Nicolò Marcucci
metaDescription: Data analyst in Jönköping, Sweden. Python data pipelines, applied economic analysis, and software I actually ship. Projects, code, and live demos.
intro: I build Python pipelines that turn raw data into analysis-ready datasets, and run applied economic analysis end to end. Right now I do that as a data analyst intern at **EODynamics AB** in Sweden, while finishing an MSc in Applied Economics and Data Analysis at **Jönköping International Business School**.
I also write software. Some of what is below is analysis and some of it is a working product — I find the two get better when the same person does both.
projectsLead: Eight projects. Each has a short write-up in plain English; where something is deployed there is a live link, and the code is on GitHub.

howIWork.title: Say what the data cannot support
howIWork.body: Every project below states its limits somewhere public — which years the data actually covers, which comparisons were never tested, what a result does not prove. A number without its caveat is not a finding.

howIWork.title: Tests that fail for the right reason
howIWork.body: I test the logic, not the markup: pure functions checked as maths, interfaces driven through real keyboard and pointer input. A test should break when the behaviour breaks, not when a class name changes.

howIWork.title: Finished means someone else can run it
howIWork.body: A project is done when a stranger can clone it, follow the README, and get the same result — or open a URL and use the thing. Analysis that only runs on my laptop is a draft.

skillsLead: Grouped by how much I actually reach for them, not by how good they look in a list.
contact: Email is the best way to reach me. If you want the short version instead, the CV is one page.
